steps.completes: the menu panel opens (panel 'open' event, or panel shown while polling)
the panel's screen changes from the one showing when the step began ('screen' event)
the panel closes ('close' event, or not shown while polling)
in single-instrument mode, layout.current differs from the instrument seen first during the step
the nod kick fired, or (desktop) any kick event, or (headset) a kick event with every hand pointer > 0.2 m from the kick pad; never during playback

chirps.envelope: gain set to peak at `at`, exponential ramp to 0.0005 at at+decay, oscillator stops at at+decay+0.05; frequency f0 at `at`, exponential ramp to f1 at at+slide

voice.engine: eSpeak NG (offline, open source); only the rendered audio ships

tips.trigger: the first time Move instruments turns on (ArrangeModeEvent Active), never over the tour
the first LOOP press ever on the tape deck (IGuide.Tip); the clicks wait for the line
tips.success: the line heard to the end
